strengths_deep_dive: Humanity for Relief and Development shows solid operational execution in direct humanitarian relief. In FY2024, the charity earned an <cite id="1">overall score of 97.3/100 from Charity Navigator</cite>, highlighting robust financial health. Furthermore, <cite id="5">Form 990 filings for FY2024</cite> report <cite id="5">$3,669,260 in total revenue</cite>, with an <cite id="5">78.1% program expense ratio</cite> that exceeds the 75% industry benchmark.
rich_narrative.summary: Humanity for Relief and Development (HRD) delivers targeted humanitarian assistance, providing direct food and medical support to vulnerable communities affected by crisis in Yemen <cite id="4">through zakat-eligible programs</cite>. Founded in 2018, the non-profit reported <cite id="5">$3,669,260 in total revenue in FY2024</cite>, directing funds toward essential interventions like the Mercy Bakery and daily nutrition for cancer patients. The organization holds a <cite id="1">97.3/100 rating from Charity Navigator</cite>, reflecting solid operational accountability. In FY2024, HRD maintained an <cite id="5">78.1% program expense ratio</cite>, while the baseline evaluation score reflects a cash-adjusted <cite id="1">program expense ratio of 78.1%</cite>. Spending remains focused on direct aid, supported by strong working capital reserves. However, the organization faces governance and evidence gaps, including a smaller four-member board and limited long-term outcome tracking, which slightly temper its overall assessment.
